analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($89,610) vs SMA5/20/50 ($88,663/$103,140/$105,115): Short-term rise followed by mid-to-long-term downtrend position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($114,183/$99,781): Below mid-to-long-term trend, maintaining strong bearishness.
· 52-week position (36.7%) + Current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.1→32.4): Entering oversold territory, weak rebound attempt.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1789.4665→-2073.0904): Worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $83,718): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($82,500): Support expected based on Pivot S1 ($78,543).
· Swing resistance ($95,680): Potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways): Trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.71x): Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Observation conditions met, cautious about entering a buy position.
